outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 141 samples is plotted as an individual marker; individual data points are the data itself, so no additional overlay is required.
Scatter plot of mean ± s.d. per cell line/reporter; scatter plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points per the check criteria.
Line/density (Gaussian) distribution curves per subtype; line plots are exempt since overlaying individual points would make them unreadable.
Boxplot of CWT ridge lengths; box plots already display the distribution and are exempt, and individual sample data points are additionally overlaid as dots on the boxes.
Polar histograms display the probability distribution of phase differences (analogous to a density/histogram plot), which does not require overlaid individual data points.
Polar histogram showing subtype-averaged phase-difference distribution; as a histogram-type distribution plot it is exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Single illustrative example trace (original signal, fitted curve, and sketched decay envelope) for one sample, not an average across replicates, so individual-point overlay is not applicable.
Scatter plot of 117 individual samples with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt since the plotted points are themselves the individual data.
